class.name: LegacyCabinLampIslands
class.brief_description: Workaround for E3D cab models: the separate lamps of a cab lamp's mesh, a light to be put at each.
class.description: A workaround for E3D cab models made for the original renderer, nothing of the original's: it lights a cab only with its ambient term, so a lamp of several bulbs (a dashboard backlight, a row of indicator dots) is one submodel there and the models do not say where the bulbs are. [method submodel_islands] guesses them from the mesh for [code]MmdCabinInstancer[/code], which puts a light at each.

method.name: submodel_islands
method.description: The pieces of [param lamp]'s mesh and of the meshes under it. Triangles joined by a shared vertex are one piece, pieces nearer than 0.02 m are one lamp, and at most 16 are kept by merging the nearest. A mesh of more than 1024 pieces is a backlight of unwelded triangles, not bulbs, and gets one light at all of it. Each is [code]{position, color}[/code]: the global centre, and the average of the piece's texture over its UV bounds, weighted by alpha, tinted by the material's [code]albedo[/code] and brought to full brightness. A texture without colour channels leaves the tint alone.
